Volcano plot for differential expression results

Source: R/plot_volcano.R
plot_volcano.Rd

Creates a publication-ready volcano plot showing fold change versus statistical significance for each protein/assay. Points are colored by significance threshold.

Usage

plot_volcano(
  data,
  pval_col = NULL,
  fc_col = NULL,
  label_col = NULL,
  assay_col = NULL,
  pval_threshold = 0.05,
  fc_threshold = 1,
  transform_fc = FALSE,
  max_labels = 15,
  title = NULL,
  padj_col = NULL,
  use_padj = FALSE,
  p_adjust_method = "BH",
  palette = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame containing differential expression results. P-value and fold-change columns are auto-detected from common names (e.g. `p.value`/`pval` and `log2FC`/`estimate`).

pval_col

Name of the column containing p-values. If NULL, auto-detected.

fc_col

Name of the column containing fold changes (on log2 scale if already transformed; set `transform_fc = TRUE` for raw ratios). If NULL, auto-detected.

label_col

Optional column with labels to display (e.g., protein names for significant hits). If NULL, `assay_col` is used for significant points.

assay_col

Name of the assay/protein identifier column. If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "Assay").

pval_threshold

P-value (or adjusted p-value) threshold for significance (default 0.05).

fc_threshold

Absolute log2 fold change threshold (default 1, i.e. 2-fold).

transform_fc

If TRUE, log2-transform the fold change column (default FALSE).

max_labels

Maximum number of top significant points to label (default 15).

title

Plot title.

padj_col

Optional name of a column containing multiple-testing adjusted p-values (e.g. `"Adjusted_pval"`, `"padj"`, `"FDR"`). Used when `use_padj = TRUE` or when explicitly supplied.

use_padj

Logical; if `TRUE`, plot and threshold on adjusted p-values (`padj_col` if present, otherwise `stats::p.adjust(pvals, method = p_adjust_method)`). Default `FALSE` (uses `pval_col`, unless `padj_col` is explicitly supplied).

p_adjust_method

Method passed to `stats::p.adjust()` when `use_padj = TRUE` and no `padj_col` column is present in `data` (default `"BH"`).

palette

Optional named or length-3 color vector for `c("Up", "Down", "NS")`.

...

Additional arguments passed to `ggplot2::geom_point()`.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Standard columns are detected automatically
plot_volcano(bansal_univariate)

# Plot adjusted p-values (BH FDR)
plot_volcano(bansal_univariate, use_padj = TRUE)
} # }
